title: Binary Prefix Divisible By 5

monster.name: Quintet Imp
monster.title: Tester of Modulo 5 Divisibility
monster.defeatQuote: Boolean prefix array where binary value is divisible by 5 generated!

description: You are given a binary array `nums`. We define `xi` as the number whose binary representation is the subarray `nums[0..i]`. Return an array of booleans `answer` where `answer[i]` is `True` if `xi` is divisible by 5.
solutionCode:
def prefixesDivBy5(nums: list[int]) -> list[bool]:
    ans = []
    val = 0
    for b in nums:
        val = ((val << 1) | b) % 5
        ans.append(val == 0)
    return ans
hints: Maintain running value modulo 5: val = ((val << 1) | b) % 5.

python.solutionCode:
def prefixesDivBy5(nums: list[int]) -> list[bool]:
    ans = []
    val = 0
    for b in nums:
        val = ((val << 1) | b) % 5
        ans.append(val == 0)
    return ans
